title: Konark Sun Temple: A Chariot Made of Stone
description: A 13th-century temple built as the sun god's chariot, with 24 carved wheels. What Konark looked like when it was complete.

scenes.narration: Imagine a temple built as a giant chariot, pulled across the sky by stone horses.
scenes.image_prompt: a colossal stone temple carved as a chariot with giant wheels and galloping stone horses, Odisha coast, dramatic sunrise sky

scenes.narration: This is Konark in Odisha, built around 1250 by King Narasimhadeva the First.
scenes.image_prompt: medieval Indian king in royal attire overseeing construction of a grand stone temple, artisans and laborers around, scaffolding, Odisha 13th century

scenes.narration: It's the chariot of Surya, the sun god, with twenty-four huge carved wheels and seven horses.
scenes.image_prompt: close view of a row of enormous intricately carved stone chariot wheels along the base of an ancient Indian temple, morning sunlight

scenes.narration: Each wheel is about three metres across, covered in carvings of everyday life, dancers and animals.
scenes.image_prompt: extreme detail of a carved stone wheel with spokes and medallions showing dancers, musicians and animals, Konark style, soft shadows

scenes.narration: People say the shadows cast by the spokes can be read like a sundial to tell the time.
scenes.image_prompt: shadow of a stone wheel spoke falling across the carved rim of a temple wheel in bright sun, a person observing it closely

scenes.narration: When complete, a towering main spire rose behind the hall, visible to sailors far out at sea.
scenes.image_prompt: complete Konark sun temple with a very tall curved stone spire behind the assembly hall, seen from a sailing ship on the Bay of Bengal

scenes.narration: European sailors called it the Black Pagoda. That great spire later collapsed.
scenes.image_prompt: 18th century European sailing ship near the Indian coast, sailors pointing at a dark stone temple tower on the shore, overcast sky

scenes.narration: What survives is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Have you been there? Tell me below.
scenes.image_prompt: present day Konark Sun Temple ruins, the surviving assembly hall with carved wheels and horses, green lawns, tourists, golden hour
